usage: 野生動物 is used to refer specifically to animals that live in natural environments and are not domesticated.
It functions as a noun and can be a subject or object in a sentence.
You can combine 野生動物 with verbs like 'observe' (觀察) or 'protect' (保護).
In sentences, it often appears with measure words like 隻 (zi1) for counting animals.
野生動物 can also be contrasted with domestic animals, so it is useful in describing wildlife versus pets or farm animals.
